candidate_relations.reason: Limbal stem-cell deficiency can follow chronic cicatrizing conjunctivitis but is not mucous membrane pemphigoid itself.
Dry eye syndrome is a secondary surface problem, not the cicatrizing autoimmune disease.
Corneal lymphangiectasia is a different corneal vascular entity from MMP.
Vernal keratoconjunctivitis is a different chronic conjunctival inflammatory disease.
Sjögren syndrome is not supported and does not produce this cicatrizing symblepharon pattern as the primary object.
Conjunctivitis is a parent surface diagnosis missing the mucous-membrane pemphigoid identity.
Giant papillary conjunctivitis is a different conjunctival entity without cicatrizing MMP features as the diagnosis.
Rosacea blepharitis is a different periocular inflammatory disease.
Mucous membrane pemphigoid matches the reference cicatrizing autoimmune diagnosis.
Cicatricial pemphigoid is a standard synonym for mucous membrane pemphigoid.
Corneal ulcer is a possible secondary surface complication, not MMP.
Trachoma is a different infectious cause of conjunctival scarring.
Uveitis is not the documented disease process, which is cicatrizing conjunctival disease.
Ocular cicatricial pemphigoid is the ocular form of mucous membrane pemphigoid and matches this eye-limited record.
Stevens-Johnson syndrome is a different cicatrizing mucocutaneous disease, typically acute and drug-triggered.
Chronic graft-versus-host disease can cicatrize the ocular surface but there is no transplant history.
Ocular pemphigus is a related immunobullous family with incompatible autoantigen/disease identity from pemphigoid.
Graft-versus-host disease is not applicable without allogeneic transplantation.
Keratoconjunctivitis sicca is a secondary dry-surface manifestation, not MMP.
Ocular rosacea is a different chronic ocular surface disease.

case_quality_flags: Conjunctival biopsy immunofluorescence was nonspecific, so MMP is a clinical-cicatrizing diagnosis in this record
